stories.title: Stocks Fall, Dollar Rallies as US Inflation Tops Forecasts
stories.summary: US inflation data came in hotter than forecast. Stocks fell and the dollar rallied after the report. The reaction suggests traders now doubt how fast the Fed will cut rates.
stories.whyItMatters: Hotter inflation reduces the odds of near-term Fed rate cuts and can press on equity valuations.
whatToWatch: Fed officials' comments on the inflation report
questions: Which parts of the inflation report drove the beat?
Will the Fed change its rate-cut plans because of this?

stories.title: Fed's Goolsbee Calls September CPI Data 'Discouraging'
stories.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the September CPI report was discouraging. His comment follows inflation data that came in above forecasts and hit markets. It is an early signal of how Fed officials view the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed officials' reactions to inflation data hint at how the central bank may handle future rate decisions.
whatToWatch: Other Fed officials' reactions to the CPI report
Signals ahead of the next Fed meeting
questions: Does Goolsbee's view match the rest of the Fed?
